title: False-discovery-controlled screening of bimetallic alloy surfaces for hydrogen evolution: code and data
description: Code and data for conformal, false-discovery-controlled screening of bimetallic alloy surfaces for the hydrogen evolution reaction using the Catalysis-Hub MamunHighT2019 dataset: data audit, surface-level descriptor, classical and simulated quantum-kernel predictors, conformal and weighted conformal selection, structure-type transfer designs, frozen analysis protocol, summary and per-split results.
